steps.title: Toolchains, workspaces, Turborepo graph and root scripts
steps.summary: Sets up the empty monorepo: pinned toolchains in mise, Bun workspaces, the Turborepo graph behind `bun run check`, and a stub for each root script (codegen, gates:canaries, guard, lint:docs, voidx, e2e, qa:validate, format) so later steps only fill their own folder.
criteria: `mise install` then `bun install --frozen-lockfile` on a clean macOS machine succeed with `MISE_LOCKED=1`.
Root scripts `codegen`, `gates:canaries`, `guard`, `lint:docs`, `voidx`, `e2e`, `qa:validate`, `format` exist; each stub points at `scripts/<name>/` and exits 0 until its step fills it.

steps.title: Tokens: DTCG source, Terrazzo, CSS and Tailwind output, contrast test
steps.summary: Builds the design-token source for Dragonfruit and Neon Night, type, spacing, radius and motion, generates CSS and Tailwind `@theme`, and tests that every colour pair is readable and inside sRGB.
criteria: Every colour token is inside the sRGB gamut, and the contrast test passes for every token pair in light and dark.
Every motion token has a value in the `reduced` context, `stagger` is 0 there and every reduced spring has bounce 0.

steps.title: Tokens: voidx-native plugin for Swift, xcassets and spring linear()
steps.summary: Adds our own Terrazzo plugin that writes Swift tokens, colour assets and spring curves to `packages/design-tokens/Generated/`, with a test that each spring settles on time.

steps.title: Core: domain types and port interfaces
steps.summary: Writes the domain model every part shares (positions, pools, tokens, chains, prices as optional values) and the port interfaces adapters implement later. Types only.

steps.title: Contracts: Zod schemas, OpenAPI files, fixtures, mock
steps.summary: Defines the first draft of the API contract, the generated `openapi.json` and Swift variant, example fixtures including unknown enum values, and the mock API the app uses before a server exists.
steps.done_when: bun run check --filter=@voidx/contracts && bun run codegen && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts
criteria: `oasdiff breaking` fails between `openapi.json` and a copy with one field removed.
A fixture with an unknown enum value decodes in `bun run check --filter=@voidx/contracts`.

steps.title: Integration kit schemas, voidx validate, chain files, infra stub
steps.summary: Creates the schemas every chain and protocol file must pass, the `voidx validate` command, the Ethereum and Arbitrum chain files and the empty `infra` package.
steps.done_when: bun run voidx validate && bun run check --filter=@voidx/integration-kit --filter=@voidx/cli --filter=@voidx/infra --filter=@voidx/integrations
criteria: `bun run voidx validate` passes on `integrations/chains/*` and fails on a canary chain file with a misspelled key and on one with an address without a source URL.

steps.title: Server and worker: createRoot, /livez, one test each
steps.summary: Starts the server and worker apps, each with a composition root and one test; the server answers `/livez`. No database yet.
criteria: `GET /livez` on the server returns 200 in its test.

steps.title: Gate runner and dependency-cruiser rules with canaries
steps.summary: Adds the canary runner (`bun run gates:canaries`) every gate registers into, and the import-boundary rules with canaries proving they fail.
steps.done_when: bun run check && bun run gates:canaries --filter=depcruise
criteria: dependency-cruiser fails on canary imports from `integrations/` into `packages/infra`, from a server route into `infra`, and into a non-exported `core` path.

steps.title: Biome rules and GritQL plugins with canaries
steps.summary: Turns on the Biome rules from the code style, the GritQL plugins against literal motion values, `z.enum` wire fields and decorators, each with a canary.
steps.done_when: bun run check && bun run gates:canaries --filter=biome
criteria: Biome fails on a canary `fetch` in `integrations/`, a `z.enum` wire field in `packages/contracts`, a decorator in `packages/`, and an `` without `alt` in Hono JSX.
A canary file breaking one code-style rule fails: a floating promise and a default export in TS.
A canary literal duration fails lint in CSS: `transition: opacity 300ms`.

steps.title: License gate with a canary
steps.summary: Adds the dependency-license check so an MIT package can never pull in a GPL dependency.
criteria: The license gate fails on a canary GPL dependency in an MIT package.

steps.title: Quiet checks, .logs/, format command and format hook
steps.summary: Makes checks agent-friendly: quiet on success, full logs in `.logs/`, a format command, and a hook that formats every file an agent edits.
criteria: With `CLAUDECODE=1`, `bun run check` prints nothing on success; on a failing canary it prints only the failure and the path of the full log.
The format hook, fed the hook JSON for a misformatted canary `.ts` and `.swift` file, formats each, exits 0 and prints nothing.
steps.owner_reason: Adds the PostToolUse hook to the committed `.claude/settings.json`, which changes only with your approval.

steps.title: lint:docs and REUSE
steps.summary: Adds the docs checks: links and anchors, Markdown structure, every AGENTS.md path exists, every skill has its link, and licence headers via REUSE.
criteria: `reuse lint` and `bun run lint:docs` (offline) pass; `lint:docs` fails on a canary `AGENTS.md` path that does not exist and on a skill without its `.claude/skills/` link.

steps.title: Guard scripts and Renovate config
steps.summary: Writes the PR guard (DCO sign-off, lockfile guard, integration path scope) as local scripts with a self-test, and the Renovate config with a 7-day release age.
criteria: A PR commit without `Signed-off-by:` fails `guard`; a lockfile change under an integration-only diff fails `guard`; a diff touching `integrations/` and `packages/core/` fails `guard`.
`renovate-config-validator` passes on the Renovate config.

steps.title: Screenshot review rubric
steps.summary: Writes the rubric agents use to judge screenshots (hierarchy, contrast, spacing, states, motion, copy), so UX review is the same every time. You approve it.
steps.owner_reason: The rubric decides what agents call good or bad UI; you approve its wording.

steps.title: iOS: Tuist project with every target
steps.summary: Creates the iOS, iPadOS and macOS project with Tuist, declaring every module, test target, the widget stub and SPM dependencies up front, so later steps never touch the manifest.
steps.done_when: tuist install && tuist generate --no-open && tuist inspect dependencies --only implicit
criteria: `tuist install && tuist generate --no-open` and `tuist inspect dependencies --only implicit` pass.

steps.title: iOS: generated APIClient and unknown-enum decode test
steps.summary: Generates the Swift API client from the contract inside `bun run codegen` and proves an unknown enum value decodes safely.
criteria: A fixture with an unknown enum value decodes in `--filter=@voidx/ios`.

steps.title: iOS: check wrapper for iPhone, iPad and macOS
steps.summary: Makes `bun run check --filter=@voidx/ios` run the tests on an iPhone simulator, an iPad simulator and macOS quietly, failing early if the Xcode version is wrong.
criteria: `bun run check --filter=@voidx/ios` runs the tests on an iPhone simulator, an iPad simulator and `platform=macOS`; `xcodebuild build -scheme VoidXWidgets` passes for iOS and macOS.

steps.title: iOS data layer: mock transport, repository, launch arguments
steps.summary: Adds the data layer that reads the mock API and the Debug-only launch arguments `apiBase`, `scenario` and `route`, with unit tests that a Release build ignores `route`.

steps.title: iOS lint gates: SwiftLint strict, custom rules, canaries
steps.summary: Turns on SwiftLint strict with the code-style rules and custom rules against literal colours and motion values, each registered as a canary.
criteria: A canary literal colour fails lint in Swift.
A canary file breaking one code-style rule fails: `ObservableObject` and `DispatchQueue` in Swift.
A canary literal duration fails lint in Swift: `.animation(.easeIn(duration: 0.3))`.

steps.title: core-green-web: everything the web UI needs passes
steps.summary: Checkpoint, not code: tokens, core, contracts, kit, server and all TS gates pass together before web UI work starts.
steps.done_when: bun run check --filter='!@voidx/ios' && bun run gates:canaries
criteria: `bun run codegen && git diff --exit-code` shows no changes.

steps.title: core-green-ios: everything the iOS UI needs passes
steps.summary: Checkpoint, not code: the shared core plus the iOS project, client, data layer and gates pass before iOS UI work starts.
steps.done_when: bun run check && bun run gates:canaries
criteria: `bun run check` passes on macOS; `bun run check --filter='!@voidx/ios'` passes on Linux.

steps.title: Web UI kit v0 and a Debug-only gallery page
steps.summary: Builds the first web pieces from generated tokens only (status chip, static range bar, card shell with four fills) with their motion and reduced branch, and a Debug-only gallery page that shows every state.
criteria: A canary literal colour fails lint in CSS.

steps.title: iOS UI kit v0 in DesignSystem
steps.summary: Builds the same pieces in SwiftUI from generated tokens only, each with its motion, reduced-motion branch and accessibility labels.

steps.title: iOS placeholder screen and gallery route
steps.summary: Adds a placeholder Portfolio screen fed by the mock API and the Debug-only gallery opened with `route=gallery`, both using only the UI kit.
criteria: Launching the iOS app with `route=gallery` shows the gallery, and the Maestro smoke flow asserts one id from it; a Release build ignores `route`.

steps.title: E2E harness: Prism, Maestro flows, simulator prepare
steps.summary: Adds the script that starts the mock API, the Maestro smoke flow and subflows, and a script that sets simulator state so screenshots repeat.
criteria: `bun run e2e` starts Prism on `openapi.mock.json`.
`bun run e2e` passes the smoke flow on the iPhone simulator; a canary flow asserting a removed id fails.

steps.title: Motion check on the simulator
steps.summary: Runs the motion tests on the simulator: every animation has its reduced branch and each iOS spring settles within 5% of its web duration.
criteria: The settling time of each spring on iOS is within 5% of its web `linear()` duration.

steps.title: Accessibility gates: audits and AX5 snapshots
steps.summary: Runs the accessibility audit on iPhone, iPad and Mac and records snapshots at default and AX5 text in light, dark and right-to-left. You approve the first baselines.
criteria: A canary unlabeled button fails `performAccessibilityAudit()`; a canary label truncated at AX5 fails its snapshot.
steps.owner_reason: The first snapshot baselines define what correct looks like, and the macOS UI test needs your one-time permission.

steps.title: Agent QA pass on the simulator and the web gallery
steps.summary: An agent drives the running app and the web gallery on fixture data, reads the UI tree, takes screenshots, judges them with the rubric and writes findings; findings never fail the step.

steps.title: CI workflow
steps.summary: Writes the single `ci.yml`: change detection, guard, check on Linux, the iOS job with the Maestro smoke step, and `ci-ok` as the one required check.
criteria: A PR touching only `docs/` runs `changes`, `guard` and `ci-ok`, and skips `check` and `ios`; `ci-ok` is the single required check.
The measured `ios` job time on the M0 PR is recorded in docs/research/repo/ci.md.
steps.owner_reason: CI runs on GitHub with settings only you can change: required checks, runner choice, secrets.

steps.title: Verify every acceptance criterion
steps.summary: A fresh read-only reviewer re-runs every acceptance criterion of the M0 spec and reports gaps; criteria that need a real PR are listed for you.
steps.done_when: bun run check && bun run gates:canaries
criteria: All acceptance criteria in the spec.
